snippet.title: SCAM WITH YOUR FRIENDS - Official Gameplay Trailer - Run a Scam Call Center
snippet.description:
Wishlist Scam with Your Friends on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4954910/Scam_With_Your_Friends?utm_source=jakehub_trailer

Join our discord!
https://discord.gg/jataterww


Scam with Your Friends is a co-op scam call center game where you and your friends scam fictional AI callers using increasingly ridiculous schemes.

Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, buy stupid stuff with your earnings, and survive your rageaholic boss’s performance reviews.
